user.title: HEMS: choose your entities
user.description: HEMS only talks to Home Assistant entities. Pick one sensor per role. This version plans in dry-run and never switches a device.

data.battery_power_positive_is_discharging: Battery power is positive while discharging
data.grid_entity: Grid power at the meter (W, positive = import)
data.inverter_output_entity: Inverter AC output (W, optional; improves the house-load estimate)
data.ev_power_entity: EV charger power (W, optional; excluded from the base load)
data.price_curve_entity: Import price sensor with a price_curve attribute (optional; fallback and cross-check)

reconfigure.title: HEMS: change the optional entities
reconfigure.description: Only the optional roles can change here; the battery, PV and grid entities stay as set up. Clear a field to stop using that role.

data.inverter_output_entity: Inverter AC output (W, optional; improves the house-load estimate)
data.ev_power_entity: EV charger power (W, optional; excluded from the base load)
data.price_curve_entity: Import price sensor with a price_curve attribute (optional; fallback and cross-check)
data.pv_extra_entities: More PV power sensors (added to the PV sensor; several arrays or inverters)
data.ev_limit_entity: EV: charge limit number (only its maximum is read)
data.meter_export_l1_entity: Grid meter: feed-in power L1 (above 0 = exporting)
data.water_heater_entity: Dashboard: water heater or tank temperature
data.legionella_last_entity: Dashboard: time of the last legionella run (sensor)
data.compare_action_entity: Dashboard: action sensor of the old battery manager (transition comparison)

error.entity_not_found: One of the chosen entities does not exist.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The entities were changed and HEMS was reloaded.

init.title: HEMS settings
init.description: Settings in the parts of the HEMS plan: modules first, then the base components they share. Fold a part open to change it, then save once.

module_battery.name: Module: battery
module_battery.description: The battery planner: capacity, power limits and the profit margin it needs.

data.min_profit_margin: Minimum profit margin (EUR per discharged kWh, net of losses)
data.hold_cost_kwh_h: Waiting cost (EUR per stored kWh per hour; 0 = off, higher charges later before a sale)

module_water_heater.name: Module: water heater
module_water_heater.description: Plans the daily heating run for the load forecast. HEMS does not control the heating.

data.water_heater_enabled: Water heater module on (plans the daily heating run for the load forecast; HEMS does not control the heating)
data.water_heater_energy_kwh: Water heater: energy of a normal heating run (kWh)
data.water_heater_hours: Water heater: length of a normal heating run (hours)
data.water_heater_night_energy_kwh: Water heater: energy of the night run (kWh, 0 = no night run)
data.water_heater_legionella_energy_kwh: Water heater: energy of the legionella run (kWh)
data.water_heater_legionella_hours: Water heater: length of the legionella run (hours)
data.water_heater_legionella_temp_c: Water heater: temperature of the legionella run (°C)
data.water_heater_legionella_min_c: Water heater: a tank at or above this counts as a legionella run (°C)

module_ev.name: Module: EV
module_ev.description: Plans when and how hard to charge the car (dry-run: nothing is written to the charger). Deadlines are local times per weekday.

data.ev_enabled: EV module on (plans the charge of the car; HEMS does not control the charger)
data.ev_target_required_pct: Required target SoC at every deadline (%)
data.ev_target_max_pct: Maximum target SoC, only through cheap quarters (%)
data.ev_max_price: Price threshold for the extra energy (EUR/kWh, effective price; surplus counts at the export price)
data.ev_solar_only: Extra energy only where PV surplus covers the minimum current

base_prices.name: Base: prices
base_prices.description: Day-ahead prices and the price components every module uses; they mirror the energy-prices add-on.

data.nordpool_enabled: Fetch day-ahead prices from Nord Pool
data.export_energy_tax: Export energy tax refund (EUR/kWh, netting only)
data.salderen_until: Netting ends on (first day without netting, empty = only the switch)
data.bonus_only_daylight: Percentage bonus only between sunrise and sunset
data.bonus_only_positive_price: Percentage bonus only for a positive market price

base_forecast.name: Base: forecasts (PV and weather)
base_forecast.description: Weather source and the PV forecast every module uses.

data.pv_gain_w_per_wm2: PV gain (W per W/m2, 0 = calibrate automatically)
data.pv_max_ac_w: Peak PV output (W): the PV forecast is clipped here; use what the panels peak at, or the inverter AC limit if that is lower

base_grid.name: Base: grid connection
base_grid.description: The limit of the connection per phase, shared by every load.

data.grid_margin_a: Margin kept free below the limit (A)

logging.name: Logging
logging.description: What HEMS writes to its decision logs.

data.trace_full_plan: Log the full plan every cycle (plans.jsonl, about 1 MB per day)

state.no_price_for_now: No price for the current quarter

apply_recommendation.name: Apply recommendation
apply_recommendation.description: Mark an open HEMS recommendation as applied and fire the hems_recommendation_applied event with what to do.

dismiss_recommendation.name: Dismiss recommendation
dismiss_recommendation.description: Hide a recommendation until the plan asks something else.

disarm_all.name: Everything to dry-run
disarm_all.description: Switch the master off and put every module back in dry-run.

unknown_recommendation.message: No open recommendation with this id (the plan may have changed)
